description.en_US: Play your local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers as a live SiYuan background: scene.pkg rendered in real time with WebGL2, videos and web wallpapers supported, with liquid-glass UI controls.
description.zh_CN: 把 Wallpaper Engine 本地壁纸变成思源笔记的实时背景：scene.pkg 用 WebGL2 实时渲染，支持视频与网页壁纸，附毛玻璃外观、壁纸属性与自动轮播。
